title: Born in Englewood in 1908; first violin lessons with Lewis Sanborn
summary: Wilson gives his birth date and place and explains how an old violin led to lessons with a German teacher at age ten.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: All Right. You were born here, in Chicago?
Out in Englewood, Illinois, really. 61st and N. ?
Oh, yeah. Well, that's part of the --
When did you first get interested in music?

Well, it's kind of funny situation. We had an old violin sitting in the corner, and my mother figured she didn't know what to do with it, and my uncle left it there. So she figured she'd give me violin lessons, and if I did all right, why she'd keep it up. So we got ahold of a violin teacher, I don't know how we got in touch with him, Mr. Stanbourn (PHONETIC), but he was a good violin teacher. He was a German.
Yeah, Lewis Sanborn. So I started taking lessons from him, and I did so well, they kept it up.
How old were you then, Quinn?
